title: [GMCP 203.038.M] Mastery: Catalog, discovery, health, compatibility, and trust intelligence
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-038-M. Pass the complete vector mastery target on the shipped production path: Local configs, running processes, package managers, the official registry and explicit endpoints reconcile into one deduplicated catalog with provenance. Active probes measure protocol/extension compatibility, health, latency and policy fitness without granting trust; recommendations explain evidence and cost; stale or conflicting records converge; and discovery never installs, enables or sends data without authorization. Consume and verify the evidence produced by requirements 01-06; reject missing, stale, unsigned, locally modified, waived, mock-only, or zero-test evidence. Task closure and roadmap prose are not proof.
